fields.Name: Example: Chapter Renewal Reminder
fields.Description: An action for the example-chapter type (B24): drafts a renewal reminder for a chapter's lapsing members. Granted to the chapter type with ChapterID bound to the space's chapter anchor, so an agent never chooses the chapter (D27, A16 for the agent's use). Test-only; it writes nothing and returns what it would send.

fields.Name: ChapterID
fields.Description: The chapter whose lapsing members are reminded. Bound by the grant to the space's chapter anchor.

fields.Name: DaysAhead
fields.Description: How far ahead a renewal counts as lapsing. The caller's own.
